body.p: Claims 12-21 are pending. In view of the foregoing amendments and the
following remarks, it is respectfully submitted that the present application is in condition for immediate allowance, and reconsideration is respectfully requested.
II. Rejection of Claims Under 35 U.S.C. 4 112
Claims 12-21 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112, second paragraph, as being indefinite.
In response, Applicants have amended the claims, rendering moot the present rejection.
In view of all of the foregoing, withdrawal of the rejection is respectfully requested.
III. Rejection of Claims Under 35 U.S.C. 44 102/103
Claims 12-15, 20 and 21 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102 as being anticipated by U.S. Publication No. 2018/0082504 to Park. Claim 19 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Park.

The present claims recite the feature of receiving first instruction signals by a frst server of a first operator of the infrastructure...a first checking by the first server of whether the instruction is able to be executed... transmitting of second instruction signals by the frst server to a second server of a platform... a second checking by the second server of whether the instruction is able to be executed. According to the present invention, there is a first server of a first operator, a second server of a platform, and two checks to ensure that the instruction can be executed. In contrast, nowhere, does Park disclose or this feature. That is, park does not disclose coordination between two servers to transmit and check instruction signals before generating control signals for the lateral and/or longitudinal guidance of the vehicle.
In view of all of the foregoing, withdrawal of the rejection is respectfully requested.
It is therefore respectfully submitted that the presently pending claims are
allowable. All issues raised by the Examiner having been addressed, an early and favorable action on the merits is earnestly solicited.
